scenario_caveats: Central values for Ru catalysts are dominated by Ru at JM spot, a market that has tripled in about 18 months; low uses the 2025 annual average.

N is taken from one paper's 'Calculated' Ni/Al2O3 price (derivation not visible) and applied to MgO, CeO2 and CaO supports; support-specific manufacturing costs not found. CeO2 oxide raw cost (1.71 USD/kg, M6) is negligible versus N.
Metal content is treated as mass fraction of finished catalyst times metal price; precursor salt, yield and loss, and refining margins are not included (no sourced values).
Published TEA Ru catalyst prices (C2 542, C3 25, C6 22.3 EUR, C7 24 USD) are below the Ru metal floor and must not be used as central values.
No recovery credit is deducted: no sourced refining charge. Gross credit upper bound = metal content x Ru price x recovery fraction (85-95% hydro, snippet-level).
